name: Lunar Dust — Frost Blue
description:
Fine regolith swept from the craters where XEN was forged into light.

UTILITY (Moon Forge program + oracle):
• +5% XEN burn score for the holder — counts only if held by the same owner at two consecutive epoch snapshots; best Artifact per wallet; it shifts shares within an epoch and never raises the epoch total
• 5 Burn Lottery chips every week (claim_artifact_chips; weeks reset Thursdays 00:00 UTC, missed weeks do not accumulate)
• Ticket to Artifact Duel: any live Artifact lets its holder create or join duels; the element played is chosen freely and hidden by commit-reveal
• Refundable floor: 5 XNT when forged; the drop value (at least 5 XNT) when won as a Forge Drop; none for Genesis airdrop Lunar Dust — recycle to get it back. The exact floor of each Artifact is its on-chain "Floor XNT" attribute
• Max 600 alive at any time; recycling frees the slot for a new forge
• Also drawn among XEN burners as Forge Drops: 10% of each epoch budget (at most 100 XNT), paid to XEN burners as part of their epoch reward, as Lunar Dust holding a floor of at least 5 XNT

Forge price 10 XNT (fixed): 50% floor, 40% burners' reward pool, 5% Burn Lottery, 5% architect; 5% royalty on secondary sales where honored.
